lineage.note: FROZEN-2 is a separate strategy. FROZEN-1 is not modified or deleted.

objective: 75-day MA entry + small initial loss + uncapped trend-following via trailing stop
universe_target: TSE domestic common stocks satisfying liquidity/history rules
implementation_universe_proxy: current monitored TOPIX100 snapshot in universe.json; exact historical all-TSE universe unavailable in this session

data_source.execution_pretest: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, actual Japanese market OHLCV; historical raw yen/share reconstructed around stock splits

liquidity.turnover_definition: raw Close * raw Volume; rolling 20-session median through signal close

atr.method: simple moving average of True Range; split-only normalized OHLC; ATR known as of signal close for initial stop

position_sizing.shares: min(risk-budget quantity, cash-affordable quantity), rounded down to 100 shares

initial_stop: entry open - 1.0 * ATR14(signal close), converted to entry-date share units if an overnight split occurs

trailing_stop.active_stop_timing: only the stop fixed by the prior close is active during the next session; today's high cannot retroactively create a same-day stop
trailing_stop.gap_rule: if Open <= active_stop, exit at Open
trailing_stop.intraday_rule: else if Low <= active_stop, exit at active_stop
trailing_stop.entry_day_rule: initial stop is active immediately after entry; if entry-day Low <= initial stop, exit at initial stop

candidate_selection: if multiple signals at a close and no position is held, select highest 20-day median turnover; while holding, new signals are ignored

corporate_actions.splits: adjust held shares and stop/high-water prices on effective date
corporate_actions.delisting_tob_halt: do not fabricate fills; data-end unresolved positions remain open/marked-to-market

cost_scenarios.application: half charged on entry notional, half on exit notional

regime.up: Close > SMA75 and SMA75 > SMA75 shifted 20 sessions
regime.down: Close < SMA75 and SMA75 < SMA75 shifted 20 sessions

verdict_rules.numeric_adopt: n>=50; expectancy_R>0.20; PF>=1.30; avg_win_R/abs(avg_loss_R)>=2.0; maxDD<=15%; stress expectancy_R>0; both development and holdout expectancy_R>0
verdict_rules.numeric_conditional: n>=30; expectancy_R>0; PF>1.10; avg_win_R/abs(avg_loss_R)>1.5; maxDD<=20%; stress expectancy_R>=0, but one robustness/subperiod criterion may fail
verdict_rules.hold: main result positive but n<30 or stress/subperiod evidence is too weak
verdict_rules.reject: expectancy_R<=0 or PF<=1.0, or materially negative stress result, or maxDD>25%
verdict_rules.evidence_quality_cap: because this execution pretest uses current TOPIX100 proxy + yfinance instead of historical all-TSE J-Quants, final verdict cannot exceed 条件付き採用

anti_optimization: No parameter, threshold, entry condition, ATR multiplier, or exit rule may be changed after results are observed.
